findings.message: int vs Integer unsafe comparison in isMaterialChange + objectsEqual duplicates Objects.equals()
Concurrent insert race (check-then-act) — addressed by DataIntegrityViolationException → 409 handler
resolveWithinDays extra DB query — could be aggregate
Cross-field modal exclusion enforced only in service, not DTO
CURRENCY_DISPLAY_NAMES duplicated in two response records
Missing @Pattern on currencyId query param in getExpiringSoon
Missing @Max(3650) on withinDays (DoS via date overflow)
Raw user-value echo in MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException handler
totalAmountAtRisk serialized as JSON number — contract requires type:string; fixed with @JsonSerialize(ToStringSerializer)

@Pattern on @PathVariable fires 400; contract says unrecognised currencyId → 422. Mitigated: format-invalid (non-alpha) correctly 400; semantic-invalid (valid format, not in set) correctly 422 via service.
currencyId filter in expiring-soon not validated against known set in service (passes unknown values to DB query)
Instant serialization confirmed ISO 8601 via write-dates-as-timestamps=false in application.yml

findings.title: Disabling/relaxing policy does not cancel pending expiry notices
findings.tierReason: FR-09.10 cancel-on-relax is explicitly deferred to US-03 per spec Out-of-Scope section

findings.title: Concurrent policy creates produce 500 instead of 409
findings.tierReason: severity=medium → advisory; fixed by adding DataIntegrityViolationException + ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException handlers → 409

tests.detail: 19/19 service tests + 10/10 controller tests = 29 total, 0 failures

advisory_findings: FR-09.10 cancel-on-relax (disable/relax cancels pending notices) — deferred to US-03 by spec design
Concurrent insert race (check-then-act in upsertPolicy) — backstop: DataIntegrityViolationException → 409 now handled
LocalDate.now()/Instant.now() without Clock injection — advisory; deferred
resolveWithinDays fires extra DB query for max(leadTimeDays) — cold path advisory; deferred
Cross-field modal exclusion (INACTIVITY vs FIXED_DATE fields) validated in service — intentional per spec (domain 422 errorCode required)
CURRENCY_DISPLAY_NAMES duplication — 4-entry map, low maintenance burden; deferred
@Pattern on path variable fires 400 for format-invalid values vs 422 — layered defense by design; semantic check in service returns 422
rc_fixes: Objects.equals() replaces unsafe int!=Integer and objectsEqual() helper
@Pattern on currencyId query param in getExpiringSoon
Raw user-value redacted from type-mismatch error handler
Redundant currencyId log removed from validateCurrencyId
